method.sampling: per deck at most 60 content pages, evenly spaced over the deck's content pages; content page = has a title and >=15 words, or a raster exhibit covering >30% of the page
method.title: largest spans (>=85% of max, >=14pt) in the top 22% of the page; title_size_pt_norm = pt * 13.333 / page width in inches
method.body_words: words in non-title spans larger than 9.5pt; lower bound where exhibits are raster images
method.empty_share: largest empty rectangle in the body band (20%-90% of page height) as a share of the band, from a bitmap rendered at <=40 dpi; pixels >225/255 are empty, so light-grey panels count as empty
method.margins: text, visible drawings and images; full-page backgrounds ignored; full-bleed bands or images give zero; text_margin_* uses text only; *_frac are fractions of page width or height
method.n_font_sizes: distinct font sizes rounded to whole points on the page
method.color_count: distinct text and drawing fill/stroke colours at 4 bits per channel, excluding near-white and near-black
method.chart_share: heuristic: vector bars (>=4 rects with common baseline and varying length) or a many-segment stroked polyline, few words inside; raster charts and pies are not detected, so a lower bound
method.table_share: heuristic: >=3 parallel horizontal rules in the body, or a text grid of >=3 columns and >=4 rows; raster and ragged borderless tables are missed
method.source_line_share: share of pages with a 'Source:' or 'Note:' span in the bottom 20%; invisible when the line sits inside a raster image
method.shares: share = pooled share of pages; per_deck = median, p10, p90 of each deck's own share
method.percentiles: linear interpolation; n = number of pages (or decks for per_deck)
